title: Squanto unites three rival tribes

tellings.quote: Uh Squanto unites creates this federation of these three tribes that were all rivals against each other

plain: The Native American man Squanto is said to have joined three Massachusetts tribes that had been rivals into one federation. A researcher named Luke Caverns says this on the show, in passing, and gives no date or source. In his telling, Squanto is the one who made old enemies into allies.
